en.topic_summary:
Hongkongers are sweltering under extreme heat this summer. On Sunday, the city broke its record for the highest temperature ever recorded at the Observatory’s Tsim Sha Tsui headquarters and, in the days that followed, the mercury surpassed 38 degrees Celsius in some parts of the territory.



Photo: Lea Mok/HKFP.
